A '''cloaking revver''' was a component of the [[Mark III Merr-Sonn Defender Ion Mine]]. In conjunction with [[particle-beam scatter projector]]s, they worked to keep the [[Mine/Legends|mine]] invisible to enemy [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]].<ref name="CRFG" />
